title: Minimax Testing of Counterfactual Density Equality over Continuous Locations and Bandwidths
banked_reason: D-0.5 NO-PASS: the balanced-frontier proposal is repo-subsumed by stat_causal_witness_multiscale_detection; angle-1 pivot found no distinct surviving seed.
gap_reasons: The failed in-catalogue qid stat_causal_witness_multiscale_detection already packages the same exact-marginal-null mixture, known-versus-unknown propensity frontier, observable higher-order multiscale attainment, and selected-scale band; narrowing to its balanced slice and repairing constructions is not a new kernel.
Its fitted higher-order location-scale calibration problem is the same unresolved D0 process targeted by stat_causal_witness_multiscale_detection rather than a distinct open question.
proof_attempt_summary: The run attempted a balanced-smoothness version of the causal density witness detection frontier and repaired defects in the proposal's exact-null construction. Two D-0.5 reviews found the theorem program already present in stat_causal_witness_multiscale_detection, and the pivot found no distinct surviving seed. No D0 derivation or Lean proof was attempted; the repaired construction may inform consolidation with the earlier run, while its empirical Bernstein calibration remains open.
tldr: The project determines the all-test Gaussian-witness boundary \(R_n(h)=\max\{\sqrt{\log(e/h)/(nh)},[\log(e/h)/(n^2h)]^{2\eta/(4\eta+1)}\}\) for equality of marginal potential-outcome densities over continuous locations and bandwidths. An explicit exact-null shared-sign family supplies the converse; a deterministically split, separately resolved pair-and-cubic estimator and an observable block-calibrated scan supply attainment. The revealed-propensity experiment yields an exact assignment-cost elbow, and a conservative simultaneous band protects a data-selected location and scale.
gap: Kim--Kim--Kennedy leave non-oracle counterfactual-density minimax lower bounds unresolved, while Zenati--Gretton establish finite-location efficiency without a shrinking-bandwidth continuum frontier. Classical scans do not contain fitted causal nuisances or higher-order degenerate corrections.
fill: The explicit zero-integral bump and shared-sign law give the exact-null mixture and separation identity. A fixed half-sample split, fine pair correction, coarse cubic correction, and truncated-block empirical-Bernstein program target the matching observable upper bound.
